description: All three easings on the same ramp, so opacity is held to the kernel's own curve rather than to a second one written at the compositing layer. 'smooth' omits ease entirely and must be smoothstep, not linear -- that is the v3 default and picking linear here would silently re-time every existing clip's fades. 'held' pins u to 0 for its whole segment, which is also why the stepped channels need no special case anywhere: hold already pins them. Each ramp runs 0 -> 1 over its own segment so the eased u is readable straight off the resolved opacity.
